info.title: six-feat public API
info.description: Artist-collaboration graph explorer, backed by Genius.com. Every endpoint below requires an authenticated Genius session (six_feat_session cookie, minted by six-feat-auth's OAuth flow) except where noted.

servers.description: Same origin as the serving six-feat instance

cookieAuth.name: six_feat_session
cookieAuth.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted Genius OAuth session, minted by six-feat-auth (see SF-API-01/IDEA-53). Anonymous requests to any endpoint below return 401.

apiKeyAuth.name: X-Api-Key
apiKeyAuth.description: Third-party integration key (SF-API-15), issued via POST /api/v1/api-keys. Alternative to cookieAuth for /api/v1/graph, /api/v1/graph/path, /api/v1/search and /api/v1/artist — an invalid or revoked key is rejected with 401 outright, never falls back to requiring the session cookie instead.

image.description: Omitted when empty (default Genius avatar normalised away, see SF-API-07)

LegacyErrorBody.description: Bespoke error shape used by the five pre-SF-API-11 handlers (graph, graph/path, search, status, status/stream) — NOT unified problem+json, pinned byte-for-byte by tests/test_api_auth_headers.py. Exact keys vary per handler (see each path's own responses below).

request_id.description: Present on every error body, absent on success bodies (SF-API-06)

ProblemJson.description: RFC 7807 application/problem+json envelope, used by handlers introduced from SF-API-11 onward (currently just /api/v1/artist).

type.description: Always "about:blank" — no dedicated per-error-code doc URI exists yet

ts.description: Unix seconds when the player earned it; absent in the catalog listing

GameAttempt.description: One row of a player's attempt history.

user_id.description: Stable FNV-1a hash of the Genius username — NOT the numeric Genius id

games.description: RANKED games — a replayed challenge does not increment it (SF-GAME-36)

from.description: Genius artist id of the start

to.description: Genius artist id of the goal

role_mask.description: Bitmask of collaboration roles the chain may use

optimal_len.description: BFS ideal hop count (the challenge's PAR); null until computed

weight.description: Total distinct-song collaboration count with the seed

roles.description: [SF-WEB-77] Every credit role this node participates in, across its edges (sorted, deduplicated). Sent so the client does not re-derive it from the raw collaborations array.

deepen_available.description: [SF-YM-09] Whether "find more connections" (Genius-only) can work for this node. Always true — Genius is the sole graph source, so every resolved node is already Genius-identified.

source.description: Which upstream produced this edge — "genius_credit" for a Genius-tagged credit role (primary/producer/writer/featured). Derived from dominant_role, not a persisted per-edge tag.

collaborations.description: [SF-WEB-77] Sorted by popularity, highest first (stable — equal popularity keeps incidence order). The client relies on this order instead of re-sorting.

name.description: Omitted if this node's artist info isn't known yet

source.description: Which upstream produced this edge — see GraphEdge.source.

get.summary: Build the collaboration graph around a seed artist
get.description: Resolves the seed (by name or numeric id), triggers on-demand foreground enrichment if not already known, and returns the current adjacency graph from L1/L2. Supports conditional GET via ETag.

parameters.name: artist
parameters.description: Seed artist name — mutually exclusive with id

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Seed artist Genius id — mutually exclusive with artist

parameters.name: roles
parameters.description: Comma-separated credit role filter (primary,featured,writer,producer); default is all roles

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Weak ETag from a prior response

get.summary: Shortest collaboration path between two artists
get.description: BFS over L1/L2 (falls back to on-demand enrichment for unknown endpoints) between two seed artists.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Source artist name or numeric id

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Target artist name or numeric id

200.description: Path found (or hops=0 / empty path if none exists)

404.description: One or both endpoints could not be resolved

500.description: Unexpected internal error while computing the path

503.description: Path search exceeded its deadline (sparse/unenriched graph) — retry later

get.summary: "Find more connections via Genius" for one artist (SF-YM-03)
get.description: On-demand deepen action for a single artist already shown in the graph (SF-YM-01/SF-YM-02). Calls GeniusMusicSourceProvider.GetCollaborationEdges directly for the given artist id, using a BYO token if connected (higher rate-limit budget than the shared session token) to find producer/writer/featured/primary edges the default foreground fetch didn't have budget to reach. Response shape mirrors GET /api/v1/graph's nodes/edges so the client can merge it into the already-rendered graph, combining sources on a same-pair edge instead of drawing a visually distinct second one.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Genius id of the artist/node to deepen — already resolved and shown in the current graph.

200.description: Deepen succeeded (possibly with zero additional edges — an honest "nothing more found", not an error)

401.description: No valid session and no valid X-Api-Key

404.description: Artist id not found on Genius

get.description: Candidate resolve only (no graph build, no background enrichment).

get.summary: Enrichment status for a previously-requested artist
get.description: Reports current fetch depth/song_count/enriching state — never triggers any fetch itself.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Strict integer artist id — trailing garbage ("123abc") is rejected

200.description: Status for the given artist id (all-zero/enriching=false if never requested)

get.description: Returns everything already known about an artist from L1/L2 only — never triggers a new Genius fetch. 404 if the artist has never been requested. Introduced by SF-API-03; error bodies use the unified problem+json envelope (SF-API-11), unlike the four legacy endpoints above.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Strict integer artist id — trailing garbage ("123abc") or a float ("1.5") is rejected

404.description: Artist not known in L1/L2 yet

post.summary: Issue a new API key for the calling user (SF-API-15)
post.description: Session-cookie-only — not reachable via X-Api-Key itself, so a leaked key can never mint further keys on its owner's behalf. The issued key inherits the session's own Genius grant/expiry: it authenticates /api/v1/graph, /api/v1/graph/path, /api/v1/search and /api/v1/artist via the X-Api-Key header exactly as the session cookie would, sharing the same CollabService codepath.

rate_tier.description: "default" or "elevated"; unrecognised values fall back to "default".

201.description: Key issued — the raw key is shown only in this response and cannot be retrieved again.

422.description: Session has no Genius display name to own this key with (also returned when Idempotency-Key is reused with a different request body)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: SF-API-16: an opaque client-chosen key. A repeated POST with the same key returns the exact cached {status, response} from the first attempt without re-running the request's side effects (e.g. without issuing/revoking a second key); a request with the same key but a different body gets 422 instead of a mismatched replay. TTL is 24h; omit the header for the existing non-idempotent behaviour.

post.summary: Revoke one of the caller's own API keys (SF-API-15)
post.description: Session-cookie-only. Only revokes when the key's owner matches the caller's own session — never another owner's key by guessing/enumerating ids.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: SF-API-16: an opaque client-chosen key. A repeated POST with the same key returns the exact cached {status, response} from the first attempt without re-running the request's side effects (e.g. without issuing/revoking a second key); a request with the same key but a different body gets 422 instead of a mismatched replay. TTL is 24h; omit the header for the existing non-idempotent behaviour.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The api_keys.id returned by the issuance response

404.description: id does not exist, belongs to a different owner, or was already revoked

422.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different request body

get.summary: Connection status for both optional personalizations (SF-YM-02)
get.description: Booleans only — never the tokens themselves. Session-authenticated: a user only ever sees their own connection state.

post.summary: Connect a personal Genius token to deepen the graph (SF-YM-02)
post.description: BYO Genius OAuth token, pasted to get a higher rate-limit budget than the shared session/service token for deepen and background enrichment. Connecting it IS the consent to use it for background enrichment of the shared database — there is no separate toggle. Session-authenticated; upserts (re-connecting replaces the previous token, never a second row).

post.summary: Disconnect the caller's own connected Genius token (SF-YM-02)
post.description: Only Genius has a personal token to disconnect — there is no personal Yandex token anymore (SF-YM-04-file).

404.description: Nothing was connected for this provider

get.description: Own profile when called with a session and no ?user; a public profile when ?user= is given. Served by six-feat-game (ADR-0007); nginx proxies /api/v1/game/* to it. Error bodies use the unified problem+json envelope.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Another player's user_id — public view, no session required

patch.description: Served by six-feat-game (ADR-0007); nginx proxies /api/v1/game/* to it. Error bodies use the unified problem+json envelope.

get.summary: Read one challenge, or today's daily (SF-GAME-16)
get.description: ?id= reads a specific challenge; ?daily=1 returns the currently published daily one. optimal_path is never exposed — only its length. Served by six-feat-game (ADR-0007); nginx proxies /api/v1/game/* to it. Error bodies use the unified problem+json envelope.

404.description: No such challenge / no daily published yet

post.summary: Create-or-get a challenge for a pair (SF-GAME-16)
post.description: Idempotent by (from, to, role_mask, kind): the same pair always returns the same challenge. Computes and caches the BFS ideal on first sight. Served by six-feat-game (ADR-0007); nginx proxies /api/v1/game/* to it. Error bodies use the unified problem+json envelope.

400.description: Missing/non-integer from or to, or from == to

404.description: One of the two artists is unknown

422.description: No path exists between the pair

get.description: Recent playable challenges, keyset-paginated, endpoints resolved to names/images. Public, no session. Served by six-feat-game (ADR-0007); nginx proxies /api/v1/game/* to it. Error bodies use the unified problem+json envelope.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: [SF-GAME-46] Substring search on the artist name at EITHER end of the pair (case-insensitive). Omit or leave empty for no filter.

post.description: Verifies every hop of a submitted chain against six-feat's internal /internal/neighbours. Never trusts the client. Served by six-feat-game (ADR-0007); nginx proxies /api/v1/game/* to it. Error bodies use the unified problem+json envelope.

invalid_hop_index.description: 0-based index of the first hop that isn't a real collaboration

400.description: Malformed body or a chain shorter than 2

post.summary: Score a finished chain and update Elo (SF-GAME-15)
post.description: Validates the chain, scores it against the challenge's own BFS ideal, and rates the player. [SF-GAME-36] Only the FIRST valid attempt at a given challenge is ranked: a replay is still scored (with the prior-attempts penalty) but never moves elo or the games count. Served by six-feat-game (ADR-0007); nginx proxies /api/v1/game/* to it. Error bodies use the unified problem+json envelope.

200.description: Scored attempt (or an honest invalid verdict)

elo_delta.description: 0 on a replay — see the anti-abuse note above

400.description: Malformed body or a chain shorter than 2

409.description: The challenge's ideal hasn't been computed yet

get.summary: Top-N for a challenge or a season (SF-GAME-17)
get.description: Read straight off game_attempts/game_profiles — there is no separate leaderboard table. Public, no session. Served by six-feat-game (ADR-0007); nginx proxies /api/v1/game/* to it. Error bodies use the unified problem+json envelope.

400.description: Neither challenge_id nor season_id given, or both

get.description: Current season (created on first sight), its podium and the achievement catalog, in one call. Public, no session. Served by six-feat-game (ADR-0007); nginx proxies /api/v1/game/* to it. Error bodies use the unified problem+json envelope.

Is `to` a real one-hop collaborator of `from`? Used by the client before letting a player add an artist to their web. Public, no session. Served by six-feat-game (ADR-0007); nginx proxies /api/v1/game/* to it. Error bodies use the unified problem+json envelope.

get.summary: Is the caller a game admin? (owner-gated)
get.description: UI-gating probe. The allowlist comes from GAME_ADMIN_GENIUS_IDS; empty (the default) means nobody is an admin and the panel never shows. Served by six-feat-game (ADR-0007); nginx proxies /api/v1/game/* to it. Error bodies use the unified problem+json envelope.

post.description: Same operation DailyChallengeTask runs once a day, triggered by hand. Omit from/to (or send 0) to let the server pick the pair. Served by six-feat-game (ADR-0007); nginx proxies /api/v1/game/* to it. Error bodies use the unified problem+json envelope.

403.description: Caller is not on the admin allowlist

422.description: The requested pair isn't connected in the graph
